title: POC Support
description: Customer support tickets with their accounts. Unity Catalog row filters limit account managers to tickets on their own accounts; reporter emails are masked for anyone who does not own the account.
instructions: "My accounts" and "my tickets" mean every row the user can see. Unity Catalog row filters already limit each user to their own accounts and those accounts' tickets. Do not add owner_email filters or any other ownership predicate.
Join poc.support.tickets to poc.sales.customer_accounts on account_id for account names.
Open means status = 'open'. High severity means severity = 'high'.
Reporter and contact emails may appear as ***@domain for users who do not own the account. Report them as masked.
sample_questions: Which of my accounts have open high-severity tickets?
How many tickets were opened per account each month?

example_sqls.question: Which of my accounts have open high-severity tickets?
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, t.ticket_id, t.opened_date, t.summary, t.reporter_email
FROM poc.support.tickets t
JOIN poc.sales.customer_accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.severity = 'high'
ORDER BY a.account_id, t.opened_date

example_sqls.question: How many tickets were opened per account each month?
example_sqls.sql:
SELECT a.account_name, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', t.opened_date) AS opened_month, count(*) AS tickets
FROM poc.support.tickets t
JOIN poc.sales.customer_accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
